thesis: Ilo is a small, plush, bottom-heavy figure in undyed linen and ink-slate wool who walks the cliff road slowly with a paper lantern raised on a pole, holds still, and then throws the flame up on a swung off-beat.

devices.device: Undyed-cloth palette: ink-slate wool over unbleached linen, ochre wood and one rust thread, nothing saturated but the flame
devices.translation: My reading of a no-brand, undyed household-goods aesthetic and a muted ink-and-ochre palette: the cloak is two slates of ink, the scarf and face are linen tones, the pole and boots are ochre-brown wood and leather, and a single rust band in the scarf is the only accent, so the lantern's flame is the only bright thing on screen.

devices.device: Round plush hood over a small bell cloak: one rounded, bottom-heavy mass with a drooping hood point and a pole rising in front
devices.translation: My interpretation of the soft, pear-shaped forest-spirit forms of a gentle hand-drawn family film and of minimal bold silhouettes: a head share near a third, one unbroken hood mass, a widening bell cloak and short legs, readable as a single dark shape at small size.

devices.device: Walker's wool kit: a long banded scarf streaming in the cliff wind, wrapped collar, ochre hip satchel, leather boots and a paper lantern on a wooden pole
qualities: a long scarf trailing across vast emptiness
devices.translation: My reading of a lone pilgrim crossing an empty landscape with cloth streaming behind it, rendered in weathered wood, paper and wool: the scarf is plain linen with rust bands (no glyphs or patterns borrowed from anywhere), the lantern is paper over a wooden frame, and everything looks hand-made and mended.

devices.device: Ritual walk: slow steps with little bounce, a slight lean, a level head, a small free-arm swing and an eased pivot turn
devices.translation: My interpretation of slow contemplative pacing and everyday ritual: 1.6 steps a second, bounciness 0.25, a 4 degree lean, an 18 degree arm swing, a head held level at 0.8 so the lantern does not jog, and a pivot turn that eases around like someone who has walked this road many times.

devices.device: Off-beat throw: dip the lantern, hold still, then swing the pole up and flick the flame free just after the beat with an overshoot
devices.translation: My reading of a laid-back, swung beat under sword-fight choreography and of sudden swells after stillness: a 3.4 second clip whose dip and hold take the first 1.4 seconds, then the arm rises and the flame leaves at 2.1 seconds, late like a swung note, with an outBack overshoot and a ring of light.

devices.device: Breathing paper lantern: a pale amber light that swells and fades slowly instead of flickering, with motes drifting upward
devices.translation: My interpretation of slow, bowed, high-register swells and of a warm glow in deep darkness: a #ffc46b light of radius 230 with a slow 1.6-speed, 0.14-amount flicker that reads as breathing, and an aura of rising ember motes.

devices.device: Plain-dream register: short, literal sentences that accept strange things calmly, a pause in the middle, no exclamations
devices.translation: My reading of a novel narrated flatly by a young runaway in a dreamlike world: Ilo states things simply, treats the stopped sun and a cold beacon as ordinary, and speaks in two short sentences per line.

lines: The cloud is quiet below the road tonight. I like it when it is quiet.
I saw the bridge. I crossed it anyway. The beacon is just up the road, then.
Wake up, Vesper. I carried this a long way for you.
I see them. Sit a while, Maren. The road will keep.

devices.device: Hand-drawn dusk portrait: Ilo small against a vast cloud sea, soft textured ink line, slate, linen and ochre, lit only by the lantern
qualities: long held wide shots with a small figure
devices.translation: My interpretation of hand-drawn animation, textured ink line and wide shots with small figures: the portrait uses painted backgrounds, a soft dark contour and the palette of dna1, with the lantern as the single warm source.
